schema.name: execution_outcome_store_versions
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE execution_outcome_store_versions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    migration_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: execution_attempts
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE execution_attempts (
    execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    evaluation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    request_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    decision_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    bounded_grant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    amount_value TEXT,
    amount_unit TEXT,
    prepared_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_digest TEXT NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: execution_terminal_observations
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE execution_terminal_observations (
    execution_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    organization_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_digest TEXT NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    certainty TEXT,
    adapter_id TEXT,
    routed_by TEXT,
    provider_ref TEXT,
    failure TEXT,
    withheld_by TEXT,
    reason_codes_json TEXT,
    observed_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    schema_version TEXT NOT NULL,
    observation_digest TEXT NOT NULL
  )

schema.name: execution_attempts_append_only_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER execution_attempts_append_only_update
    BEFORE UPDATE ON execution_attempts
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution attempts are immutable'); END

schema.name: execution_attempts_append_only_delete
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER execution_attempts_append_only_delete
    BEFORE DELETE ON execution_attempts
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution attempts are immutable'); END

schema.name: execution_terminal_observations_append_only_update
schema.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER execution_terminal_observations_append_only_update

    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution terminal observations are immutable'); END

schema.name: execution_terminal_observations_append_only_delete
schema.sql:

    BEFORE DELETE ON execution_terminal_observations
    BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'execution terminal observations are immutable'); END
